author: Nintendo of America
description:
The Pokémon Pokopia game is available now, only on the Nintendo Switch 2 system. https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/pokemon-pokopia-switch-2/ 

Get cozy and take a look at what the critics have to say about Pokémon Pokopia! Gather materials to create items and furniture, till the fields to grow crops and cook them into delicious meals, create habitats for the Pokémon you meet, and more!

You can also invite up to three other players, via local wireless* or online**, to visit and hang out together—and each of them can bring a Pokémon along. You can even invite a friend who doesn’t have the game—whether they are on Nintendo Switch 2 or Nintendo Switch—by using GameShare***!

Have you started building your Pokémon paradise yet?

* Additional games and systems required for multiplayer mode. Sold separately.

author: Nintendo of America
description:
The Pokémon Champions game launches April 8, 2026 on the Nintendo Switch system. https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/pokemon-champions-switch/

Pokémon battles for everyone! Recruit Pokémon in-game or transfer them from Pokémon HOME, then gear up for thrilling battles with Trainers near and far! Compete in three different modes of Pokémon battles: Ranked Battles, Casual Battles, and Private Battles. You can challenge these modes in both Single Battle and Double Battle formats. Plus, use in-game Victory Points (VP) you’ve earned to improve a Pokémon’s stats, acquire new looks for your Trainer, and more!

The game is also compatible with the Nintendo Switch 2 system.
